action_items.detail: JRN-32: the criterion expects yellow 'Internal note' cards on GB-1076, but GB-1076 is unassigned and the mock only generates notes for assigned tickets (mocks/conversations.ts push(... s.note ...) if t.assignee). Notes were verified on GB-1074 instead (yellow bg rgb(252,231,191)). Either seed a note on GB-1076 or update the journey.
JRN-38: the 'Return label sent' macro body uses {{order.carrier}} (filled with 'FedEx'), not the customer's first name. First-name fill was verified with 'Warm greeting' -> 'Hi Marcus,' on GB-1065.
Needs-human rows are not amber themselves. Only the 'Needs human' status pill is amber (rgb(240,168,48)), and the row background is transparent. Fine if 'amber rows' means the pill.
At 1440px the conversation column is only about 325px wide between the list (339px) and the details sidebar (319px), so the header controls wrap onto 3 lines and squeeze the thread.

Frontend-only prototype (no backend, no /api/openapi.json), so there is no backend lane. Data resets on reload, so in-memory mutations of seeded tickets don't persist. Composer text in checks uses the 'tscheck' prefix.
